newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian Gujarat cotton prices up on mill buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian Gujarat cotton prices up on mill buying.

text.p: Indian Gujarat cotton prices rose on fresh mill buying while Punjab varieties remained steady on Friday, dealers said.
They said thin supplies at the tail end of the season also sent prices up.

In spot deals Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) rose by 200/400 rupees to 12,000/12,500 rupees per candy (355.56). Wagad cotton rose by 300 to 10,700/10,800 rupees while Kala-ginned gained by 200 to 9,600/9,700 rupees. Punjab cotton was steady.
Overall export demand remained low and hardly few thousand bales (170 kg each) were traded at 58/60 cents per pound.
